data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘hassanah’, meaning ‘graceful’, ‘charming’, or ‘pleasing’. The name Hassina symbolizes the innate ability to spread joy and charm in one's surroundings. The name Hassina carries the meaning “A charming one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hassina usually hope their child will grow to embody a charming one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
